passages.title: 蒙眼試吃的科學課
passages.text: In science class today, we did a fun test about taste. Our teacher covered our eyes with cloth, and then she gave us four small cups to try. The first cup had sugar water in it. It was very {1}, and everyone smiled. The second cup had sea salt in it. "Ugh, it's so {2}!" said Leo. The third cup had lemon juice, and it was so {3} that my face moved all by itself. The last cup was the worst. It had black tea with no sugar, and it tasted very {4}. Some students wanted to spit it out. At the end of the class, our teacher {5} that our tongues help us find out if food is safe. Bitter or sour food can sometimes be bad for us, so our bodies are careful about it.

blanks.why: 糖水的味道很甜 sweet，大家都笑了。honest（誠實的）、careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）都是形容人的字，不能形容味道。
海鹽水很鹹 salty。lazy（懶惰的）、brave（勇敢的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
檸檬汁很酸 sour，酸到臉皺起來。rude（無禮的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容檸檬汁。
不加糖的紅茶很苦 bitter，有人想吐出來。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容味道。
explain that…「解釋說…」。arrived（到達）、happened（發生）、belonged（屬於）都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 今天的自然課，我們做了一個有關味覺的有趣測驗。老師用布蒙住我們的眼睛，然後給我們四個小杯子試喝。第一杯是糖水，很甜，大家都笑了。第二杯加了海鹽。「噁，好鹹！」Leo 說。第三杯是檸檬汁，酸到我的臉自己皺了起來。最後一杯最可怕，是不加糖的紅茶，喝起來非常苦，有些同學想把它吐出來。下課前，老師解釋說，舌頭能幫助我們分辨食物是否安全。苦的或酸的食物有時候可能對身體不好，所以我們的身體會對它們特別小心。

passages.title: 標籤掉了的罐子
passages.text: Last weekend, my little brother was playing in the kitchen, and he pulled all the labels off Mom's jars. Now nobody knew what was inside them! That evening, Dad wanted to make tomato eggs. He took a spoon of white powder from one jar and put it in. When we {1} it, it was as {2} as candy. That jar was sugar! Dad tried again. This time, he used a different jar, and the eggs became so {3} that we all drank lots of water. Then he added some red powder from a third jar, hoping it was paprika. But it was chili powder, and the eggs became too {4} to eat. Finally, Mom came home and {5}. She made new labels for all the jars, and my brother had to help her.

blanks.why: taste it「嚐一嚐」，吃了才知道味道。invited（邀請）、counted（數）、lent（借出）都不是吃東西時做的事。
as sweet as candy「像糖果一樣甜」，所以那罐是糖。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、careless（粗心的）都不能形容味道。
加錯罐子，蛋變得很鹹 salty，大家猛喝水。polite（有禮貌的）、brave（勇敢的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容味道。
加了辣椒粉，太辣 spicy 而吃不下。shy（害羞的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容食物。
媽媽回來看到這個情形，笑了 laughed。lent、borrowed（借來）、counted 都需要受詞，放在這裡句意不完整。

passages.zh: 上週末，弟弟在廚房玩，把媽媽所有罐子上的標籤都撕掉了，現在沒有人知道裡面裝什麼！那天晚上，爸爸想做番茄炒蛋。他從一個罐子裡舀了一匙白色的粉加進去，我們嚐了一口，竟然跟糖果一樣甜，那罐是糖！爸爸又試了一次，這次他用了另一個罐子，結果蛋鹹到我們都猛喝水。接著他從第三個罐子加了一些紅色的粉，希望那是紅椒粉。但那是辣椒粉，蛋辣到根本吃不下。最後媽媽回到家，笑了出來。她幫所有罐子做了新標籤，還要弟弟一起幫忙。

passages.title: 海水為什麼是鹹的？
passages.text: Last summer, my family went to Kenting. As soon as we got to the beach, I ran into the sea. A big wave hit me, and some sea water went into my mouth. It was so {1} that I {2} again and again. "Why is the sea so salty?" I asked Dad. Dad said that for millions of years, rivers have carried tiny bits of salt from rocks into the sea. When the sun heats the sea, the water goes up into the sky, but the salt {3} in the sea. So the sea gets saltier and saltier. Later, Mom bought us some watermelon. It was cold and {4}, and it took the salty taste away. My sister chose green mango with plum powder instead. It was {5} and sweet at the same time. I learned something new and ate something yummy that day.

blanks.why: 海水很鹹 salty，下一句也問 Why is the sea so salty。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、lazy（懶惰的）都不能形容海水。
喝到海水，鹹到一直咳嗽 coughed。invited（邀請）、borrowed（借來）、counted（數）都需要受詞，也不是喝到鹹水的反應。
水蒸發了，但鹽留在 stays 海裡。marries（結婚）、spells（拼字）、prays（祈禱）都不能說明鹽的情況。
西瓜冰涼又甜 sweet，把鹹味沖掉。careless（粗心的）、rude（無禮的）、brave（勇敢的）都不能形容西瓜。
青芒果加梅子粉，又酸 sour 又甜。shy（害羞的）、patient（有耐心的）、nervous（緊張的）都不能形容芒果的味道。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去墾丁。一到海灘，我就衝進海裡。一個大浪打過來，一些海水跑進我嘴巴裡，鹹到我一直咳嗽。「為什麼海水這麼鹹？」我問爸爸。爸爸說，幾百萬年來，河流把岩石裡的小顆鹽粒帶進海裡。太陽把海水曬熱時，水會跑到天空中，但鹽會留在海裡，所以海水就越來越鹹。後來，媽媽買了西瓜給我們吃，冰冰甜甜的，把嘴裡的鹹味都帶走了。我妹妹則選了加梅子粉的青芒果，吃起來又酸又甜。那天我學到了新知識，也吃到了好吃的東西。

passages.title: 台南的甜味料理
passages.text: My cousin Wei lives in Tainan. Last winter, I stayed at her house for a week. On the first morning, she took me to eat beef soup. The soup was not {1} at all, and the beef was very fresh. For lunch, we had bowl rice cakes with a thick brown sauce. The sauce was so {2} that I asked, "Is there sugar in it?" Wei laughed. "Tainan food is famous for being sweet. Our grandparents {3} that sugar makes food taste better." Then she gave me a bottle of chili sauce. "If it's too sweet for you, you can add this. It's very {4}, so only use a little." I put in too much, and my mouth was on fire! By the end of the week, I loved Tainan food. Now, when I eat at home, everything tastes a little too {5} to me.

blanks.why: 牛肉湯一點也不鹹 salty，牛肉很新鮮。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、lazy（懶惰的）都不能形容湯。
醬汁甜 sweet 到我問裡面有沒有糖。careless（粗心的）、brave（勇敢的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容醬汁。
believe that…「相信…」。happen（發生）、arrive（到達）、belong（屬於）都不能接 that 子句。
辣椒醬很辣 spicy，所以只能加一點。rude（無禮的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容辣椒醬。
吃慣了台南的甜，回家後覺得每樣東西都有點太鹹 salty。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容食物的味道。

passages.zh: 我表姊阿薇住在台南。去年冬天，我在她家住了一個星期。第一天早上，她帶我去吃牛肉湯，湯一點也不鹹，牛肉非常新鮮。午餐我們吃了淋上濃稠醬汁的碗粿，醬汁甜到我忍不住問：「裡面有加糖嗎？」阿薇笑了。「台南的食物就是以甜出名。我們的阿公阿嬤相信，糖會讓食物更好吃。」接著她拿給我一瓶辣椒醬。「如果你覺得太甜，可以加這個。它很辣，只能加一點點。」結果我加太多，嘴巴像著火一樣！到了那個星期的最後，我已經愛上台南的食物。現在在家吃飯，我反而覺得每樣東西都有點太鹹了。

passages.title: 屏東的辣椒農場
passages.text: Last month, our class visited a chili pepper farm in Pingtung. The farmer, Uncle Chen, has grown peppers for thirty years. He showed us red, green, and yellow peppers. "Some peppers are {1}, and some are very hot," he said. He gave us a big red one to try. It was crunchy and sweet, like an apple. Then he held up a tiny pepper. "This one is the most {2} on my farm. Who wants to try?" Nobody said a word. Finally, our teacher was {3} enough to take a small bite. Her face turned red, and tears came out of her eyes. Uncle Chen quickly gave her a glass of milk. "Milk is better than water for spicy food," he said. Before we left, he gave each of us a bottle of his chili sauce. It is not just spicy. It is also a little {4}, because he adds lemon juice. My dad loves it. He puts it on everything, even {5}!

blanks.why: 有些辣椒是甜的 sweet，有些很辣，後面的紅椒也說 crunchy and sweet。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容辣椒。
the most spicy「最辣的」，老師吃了眼淚都流出來。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容辣椒。
brave enough to…「夠勇敢去…」，大家都不敢只有老師敢。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容老師敢不敢。
加了檸檬汁，所以有點酸 sour。patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）、nervous（緊張的）都不能形容辣椒醬。
什麼都加辣椒醬，連水餃 dumplings 也加。seasons（季節）、lessons（課）、tickets（票）都不能沾醬吃。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們班去參觀屏東的一座辣椒農場。農夫陳伯伯種辣椒已經三十年了，他給我們看紅色、綠色和黃色的辣椒。「有些辣椒是甜的，有些非常辣。」他說。他給我們一顆大紅椒試吃，脆脆甜甜的，就像蘋果一樣。接著他拿起一顆小小的辣椒。「這是我農場上最辣的一種，誰想試試看？」沒有人說話。最後，我們老師鼓起勇氣咬了一小口。她的臉一下子變紅，眼淚都流了出來。陳伯伯趕快給她一杯牛奶。「吃辣的時候，牛奶比水有用。」他說。離開前，他送我們每人一瓶他做的辣椒醬。它不只辣，還有一點酸，因為他加了檸檬汁。我爸爸超愛的，什麼都加，連水餃也是！

passages.title: 外婆的苦瓜湯
passages.text: My grandma loves bitter melon. Every summer, she cooks bitter melon soup for the whole family. "It is good for your body when the weather is hot," she says. But I {1} it. The first time I tried it, it was so {2} that I almost cried. Last week, Grandma taught me her secret. First, she cut the melon and took out the white part inside. "That part makes it more bitter," she said. Then she put the pieces in {3} water for ten minutes. Finally, she cooked them with pork bones and small fish. When I tried the soup this time, it was not bad at all. It even tasted a little {4} at the end. I ate two {5}, and Grandma was very happy.

blanks.why: hate it「討厭它」，後面說第一次喝差點哭出來。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、belong（屬於）都不能接受詞 it。
苦瓜湯苦 bitter 到我差點哭出來。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、careless（粗心的）都不能形容湯。
把苦瓜泡在鹽水 salty water 裡，可以去苦味。polite（有禮貌的）、rude（無禮的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容水。
這次喝到最後還有一點甜 sweet。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、nervous（緊張的）都不能形容味道。
two bowls「兩碗」，湯用碗裝。seasons（季節）、lessons（課）、tickets（票）都不能當湯的量詞。

passages.zh: 我外婆很愛苦瓜。每年夏天，她都會煮苦瓜湯給全家人喝。「天氣熱的時候，這對身體很好。」她說。但我很討厭苦瓜。第一次喝的時候，苦到我差點哭出來。上星期，外婆教了我她的祕訣。首先，她把苦瓜切開，把裡面白色的部分拿掉。「那部分會讓它更苦。」她說。接著她把苦瓜塊泡在鹽水裡十分鐘。最後，再和豬骨、小魚乾一起煮。這次我喝湯時，覺得一點也不難喝，喝到最後甚至有一點甜。我喝了兩碗，外婆非常開心。

passages.title: 夏天的酸梅湯
passages.text: In summer, my grandpa makes sour plum juice. He boils dried plums and a little tea in a big pot for two hours. Then he adds rock sugar. The juice is dark red, and it smells {1}. When you drink it cold, it is {2} and sweet at the same time. Grandpa says it is the best drink after a meal of {3} or fried food, like fried chicken. He sells his juice at a small stand near the temple. On hot days, people {4} in a long line to buy it. His juice is so {5} that it is often sold out by four o'clock. I help him on weekends, and he pays me with a big cup of juice. It is the best pay in the world.

blanks.why: smell sweet「聞起來甜甜的」，因為加了冰糖。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容味道。
酸梅湯又酸 sour 又甜。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容飲料。
吃完鹹的 salty 或炸的食物後最適合喝。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容食物。
wait in a long line「排長長的隊等候」。belong（屬於）、happen（發生）、agree（同意）都不能和 in a long line 一起表示排隊。
很受歡迎 popular，所以四點前常常賣完。wooden（木製的）、thirsty（口渴的）、careless 都不能說明賣完的原因。

passages.zh: 夏天的時候，我爺爺會煮酸梅湯。他把烏梅和一點茶葉放進大鍋裡煮兩個小時，再加入冰糖。煮好的酸梅湯是深紅色的，聞起來甜甜的。冰冰地喝，又酸又甜。爺爺說，吃完鹹的或炸的食物，像是炸雞，最適合喝這個。他在廟旁邊擺了一個小攤子賣酸梅湯。天氣熱的時候，大家排著長長的隊來買。他的酸梅湯很受歡迎，常常不到四點就賣光了。週末我會去幫忙，他用一大杯酸梅湯當作我的工錢。那是全世界最棒的工錢。

passages.title: 中藥行的三種味道
passages.text: My uncle {1} a Chinese medicine shop on an old street. The shop is full of small wooden drawers, and every drawer has a different herb inside. When you walk in, the air smells a little {2}, like old tea. Last week, I had a cold, so my uncle made me some medicine. It was black and very bitter. "Do I really have to drink it?" I asked. My uncle smiled and said, "Good medicine is always bitter." After I finished it, he gave me a spoon of honey. It was {3} and took the bad taste away. Then he gave me a dried plum. It was {4}, and it made my mouth water. "Three tastes in one day," he said. "That's what life is like." After drinking his medicine for three days, I {5} much better.

blanks.why: own a shop「擁有一家店」，own 可以接受詞。happens（發生）、arrives（到達）、belongs（屬於）都不能直接接受詞。
中藥行的空氣聞起來有點苦 bitter，像老茶。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容氣味。
蜂蜜很甜 sweet，把苦味帶走。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容蜂蜜。
梅子乾很酸 sour，讓人流口水。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容梅子。
feel much better「感覺好多了」。happened（發生）、arrived（到達）、belonged（屬於）都不能接 much better 表示身體狀況。

passages.zh: 我舅舅在一條老街上開了一家中藥行。店裡滿是木頭做的小抽屜，每個抽屜裡都放著不同的藥材。一走進去，空氣聞起來有點苦，像放很久的茶。上星期我感冒了，舅舅幫我煮了一帖藥，黑黑的，非常苦。「我真的一定要喝嗎？」我問。舅舅笑著說：「良藥苦口。」我喝完後，他給我一匙蜂蜜，甜甜的，把苦味都帶走了。接著他又給我一顆梅子乾，酸得讓我直流口水。「一天吃到三種味道，」他說，「人生就是這樣。」喝了三天他的藥之後，我感覺好多了。

passages.title: 會變味道的魔法糖果
passages.text: On my way home from school, I found a small shop that I had never seen before. An old woman sat behind the counter. "Try this," she said, and she gave me a rainbow candy. "It's magic." I put it in my mouth. First, it was {1}, like strawberry jam. A minute later, it became {2}, like a lemon. Then it turned {3}, and my mouth felt hot. At last, it was so {4} that I wanted to spit it out. "Why does it end like that?" I asked. The old woman smiled. "Because life is like that. You have to enjoy the sweet part while you can." When I {5} around to say thank you, the shop was gone. Only an empty wall stood there.

blanks.why: 一開始很甜 sweet，像草莓果醬。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容糖果。
接著變酸 sour，像檸檬。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
然後變辣 spicy，嘴巴覺得熱熱的。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容味道。
最後苦 bitter 到想吐出來。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容味道。
turn around「轉身」。happened（發生）、belonged（屬於）、agreed（同意）都不能和 around 搭配表示轉身。

passages.zh: 放學回家的路上，我發現一家以前從來沒看過的小店。一位老婆婆坐在櫃台後面。「試試看這個。」她說，然後給我一顆彩虹糖果。「這是魔法糖果。」我把它放進嘴裡。一開始很甜，像草莓果醬；一分鐘後變酸了，像檸檬；接著變辣，我的嘴巴熱熱的；最後苦到我想把它吐出來。「為什麼最後是這個味道？」我問。老婆婆笑了。「因為人生就是這樣。甜的時候，要好好享受。」我轉身要跟她說謝謝時，那家店已經不見了，只剩下一面空空的牆。

passages.title: 只吃辣的龍
passages.text: Long ago, a dragon lived on a mountain near a small village. Every month, he flew down and asked for food. The villagers gave him rice, {1} fish, and {2} fruit, but he was never happy. "This food is not {3} enough!" he shouted, and fire came out of his mouth. The villagers were scared. Then a little girl named Mei had an idea. She {4} every chili pepper in the village and made a big pot of soup. The soup was so hot that nobody else could even smell it. The dragon drank the whole pot. "Finally! This is perfect!" he said happily. After that, the villagers grew chili peppers in every field, and the dragon was so thankful that he {5} the village from then on.

blanks.why: salty fish「鹹魚」。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容魚的味道。
sweet fruit「甜的水果」。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容水果。
not spicy enough「不夠辣」，後面女孩用辣椒煮湯才讓龍滿意。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容食物。
collect every chili pepper「收集所有辣椒」。happened（發生）、arrived（到達）、belonged（屬於）都不能接受詞。
protect the village「保護村莊」。cried（哭）、laughed（笑）、prayed（祈禱）都不能直接接受詞 the village。

passages.zh: 很久以前，一座小村莊附近的山上住著一條龍。每個月，牠都會飛下來要食物。村民給牠米飯、鹹魚和甜甜的水果，但牠從來不滿意。「這些食物不夠辣！」牠大吼，嘴裡噴出火來。村民們都很害怕。後來，一個叫小美的女孩想到一個辦法。她把村子裡所有的辣椒都收集起來，煮了一大鍋湯。那鍋湯辣到別人連聞都不敢聞。龍把整鍋湯都喝光了。「終於！這太完美了！」牠開心地說。從那以後，村民在每塊田裡都種辣椒，而龍非常感激，從此一直保護著這個村莊。

passages.title: 和韓國同學做泡菜
passages.text: Our class has a new student from Korea named Jisoo. Last Friday, she taught us how to make kimchi. First, we cut a big cabbage in half and covered it with salt. "Leave it for two hours, and it will become soft and {1}," she said. Then we made a red paste with chili powder, sugar, and some other things. The paste smelled very {2}, and some of us started to sneeze! Next, we put the paste on every leaf of the cabbage. Jisoo said we had to {3} a few days before eating it. A week later, she brought the kimchi to class. It was a little {4} now, and it tasted great with rice. Even our teacher, who usually can't eat spicy food, ate a whole {5} of it!

blanks.why: 用鹽醃過的白菜會變軟、變鹹 salty。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容白菜。
辣椒醬聞起來很辣 spicy，大家開始打噴嚏。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容氣味。
要等 wait 幾天才能吃。belong（屬於）、happen（發生）、spell（拼字）都不能和 a few days before eating it 一起表示等候。
放了一個星期，泡菜變得有點酸 sour。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容泡菜。
a whole bowl of it「一整碗」。season（季節）、lesson（課）、ticket（票）都不能當食物的量詞。

passages.zh: 我們班有一位從韓國來的新同學，叫智秀。上星期五，她教我們做韓式泡菜。首先，我們把一顆大白菜切成兩半，用鹽蓋滿。「放兩個小時，它就會變軟、變鹹。」她說。接著，我們用辣椒粉、糖和其他材料調了一碗紅色的醬。那醬聞起來非常辣，有些人開始打噴嚏！然後，我們把醬抹在白菜的每一片葉子上。智秀說要等幾天才能吃。一個星期後，她把泡菜帶來班上。它現在有一點酸了，配白飯非常好吃。就連平常不太能吃辣的老師，都吃了一整碗！

passages.title: 鹹酥雞攤的三個問題
passages.text: Every Friday night, my family buys fried chicken from the stand on the corner. The owner always asks us three questions. First: "Do you want it {1}?" My dad always says, "Very spicy!" My mom says, "Just a little." Second: "Do you want basil?" We all say yes, because fried basil smells so good. Third: "Do you want plum powder on your sweet potato fries?" Of course we do. The plum powder makes the fries {2} and a little {3}. When we get home, we finish everything in ten minutes. It is a little too {4}, so Mom always makes us drink lots of water. "This is the last time," she says every week. But the next Friday, she is always the first one to {5}.

blanks.why: 要不要辣 spicy，爸爸回答 Very spicy。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容雞肉的口味。
梅子粉讓薯條變甜 sweet。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容薯條。
又甜又有一點酸 sour，是梅子粉的味道。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容味道。
炸物有點太鹹 salty，所以要多喝水。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容食物。
the first one to order「第一個點餐的人」，說是最後一次卻又搶著買。belong（屬於）、happen（發生）、spell（拼字）放在這裡都不合句意。

passages.zh: 每個星期五晚上，我們家都會在轉角的攤子買鹹酥雞。老闆總是問我們三個問題。第一：「要辣嗎？」爸爸每次都說：「很辣！」媽媽說：「一點點就好。」第二：「要加九層塔嗎？」我們都說要，因為炸九層塔實在太香了。第三：「地瓜薯條要撒梅子粉嗎？」當然要。梅子粉讓薯條甜甜的，又帶一點酸。回到家後，我們十分鐘就把東西全部吃光。它有點太鹹了，所以媽媽總是叫我們多喝水。「這是最後一次。」她每個星期都這麼說。但到了下個星期五，第一個開口點餐的永遠是她。

passages.title: 太空人愛吃辣
passages.text: Did you know that many astronauts love {1} food in space? On Earth, they may not like it at all. But in space, their noses are often blocked. Without a good sense of smell, most food tastes boring, so astronauts often ask for hot sauce. Some of them say that even {2} food like chocolate does not taste as good as it does on Earth. Salt is also a problem. You can't put salt on your food in space, because the tiny pieces would float around, get into the machines, and {3} them. So astronauts use {4} water instead. What about drinks? Their {5} black coffee comes in a bag, and they drink it through a straw. Eating in space is not easy, but astronauts always find a way.

blanks.why: 太空人在太空中很愛吃辣 spicy，後面也說會要辣醬。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容食物。
sweet food like chocolate「像巧克力這樣的甜食」。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容巧克力。
鹽粒跑進機器會把機器弄壞 break。cheer（歡呼）、pray（祈禱）、laugh（笑）都不能接受詞 them 表示弄壞。
不能撒鹽，只好用鹽水 salty water。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容水。
黑咖啡是苦的 bitter。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容咖啡的味道。

passages.zh: 你知道很多太空人在太空中很愛吃辣嗎？在地球上，他們可能一點也不喜歡辣。但在太空中，他們的鼻子常常是塞住的。沒有好的嗅覺，大部分食物吃起來都很無聊，所以太空人常常要辣醬。有些太空人說，就連巧克力這種甜食，也沒有在地球上那麼好吃。鹽也是個問題。在太空中不能在食物上撒鹽，因為小小的鹽粒會到處飄，跑進機器裡把機器弄壞，所以太空人改用鹽水。那飲料呢？他們苦苦的黑咖啡裝在袋子裡，要用吸管喝。在太空吃東西並不容易，但太空人總是有辦法。

passages.title: 臭豆腐配泡菜
passages.text: My American friend Tyler was {1} of stinky tofu. "It smells like old socks!" he said. But last Saturday, I finally got him to try it at the night market. The fried tofu was hot and crispy outside and soft inside. I put some pickled cabbage on top. It was {2} and {3}, and it made the tofu taste even better. Then I added some chili sauce. "Is it {4}?" Tyler asked. "Only a little," I said. He closed his eyes and took a small bite. Then he took another bite, and another. "Wait. This is really good!" he said. Now Tyler eats stinky tofu every week, and he always asks for extra pickled cabbage. He even made a video to {5} it with his family in the U.S.

blanks.why: be afraid of…「害怕…」，因為他覺得臭豆腐聞起來像舊襪子。national（國家的）、wooden（木製的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 of 表示害怕。
台式泡菜又酸 sour 又甜。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容泡菜。
泡菜帶甜味 sweet。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容泡菜。
加了辣椒醬，所以問會不會辣 spicy。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容食物。
share it with his family「和家人分享」。happen（發生）、belong（屬於）、arrive（到達）都不能接受詞 it 和 with。

passages.zh: 我的美國朋友 Tyler 很怕臭豆腐。「它聞起來像舊襪子！」他說。但上星期六，我終於在夜市說服他試試看。炸臭豆腐外皮又燙又酥，裡面很軟。我在上面放了一些泡菜，泡菜酸酸甜甜的，讓臭豆腐更好吃。接著我加了一些辣椒醬。「會辣嗎？」Tyler 問。「只有一點點。」我說。他閉上眼睛，咬了一小口，接著又咬一口，再一口。「等等，這真的很好吃！」他說。現在 Tyler 每個星期都吃臭豆腐，而且每次都要多加泡菜。他甚至拍了一支影片，跟他在美國的家人分享。

passages.title: 媽媽的糖醋排骨
passages.text: My favorite dish is Mom's sweet and sour pork ribs. Last Sunday, I asked her to {1} me how to make it. First, she fried the ribs until they were brown. Then she made the sauce with vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce. "The vinegar makes it {2}, and the sugar makes it {3}," she explained. "And the soy sauce makes it a little {4}. A good dish needs a balance of tastes." I stirred the sauce while Mom added the ribs. The kitchen smelled wonderful. When Dad came home, he ate six pieces before dinner even started. "Hey! Those are for dinner!" Mom shouted. Dad just smiled. "I'm only {5} if they are good enough for you." Mom shook her head, but she was smiling too.

blanks.why: teach me how to…「教我怎麼…」。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、belong（屬於）都不能接「人 how to…」。
醋讓它變酸 sour。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容味道。
糖讓它變甜 sweet。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
醬油讓它有點鹹 salty。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容味道。
check if…「檢查是否…」，爸爸找藉口說他在試吃。marrying（結婚）、praying（祈禱）、happening（發生）都不能接 if 子句表示檢查。

passages.zh: 我最喜歡的菜是媽媽做的糖醋排骨。上星期天，我請她教我怎麼做。首先，她把排骨炸到變成褐色。接著，她用醋、糖和醬油調醬汁。「醋讓它變酸，糖讓它變甜，」她解釋，「醬油讓它有一點鹹。一道好菜需要各種味道的平衡。」媽媽把排骨放進去時，我在旁邊攪拌醬汁，整個廚房好香。爸爸回到家，晚餐還沒開始就吃了六塊。「喂！那是晚餐要吃的！」媽媽大叫。爸爸只是笑著說：「我只是在檢查它們夠不夠好吃，能不能給你吃。」媽媽搖搖頭，但她也笑了。

passages.title: 怪味豆挑戰
passages.text: My brother is a big fan of Harry Potter. For his birthday, I bought him a box of "every flavor" jelly beans, just like the ones in the movies. Each bean has a different taste, and you can never know which one you will get. We took turns. My first bean was strawberry, and it was {1}. My brother got lemon, and it was so {2} that he closed his eyes. Then my sister got a black bean that tasted like pepper. It was very {3}, and she drank a whole glass of milk. The worst one was a green bean. It tasted like old grass, and it was so {4}. My brother laughed so hard that he fell off his chair. "This is the best gift ever!" he said. We {5} to play again with our cousins at Chinese New Year.

blanks.why: 草莓口味是甜的 sweet。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容糖果。
檸檬口味酸 sour 到閉上眼睛。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
胡椒口味很辣 spicy，所以喝了一整杯牛奶。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容味道。
像舊草的味道，很苦 bitter。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容味道。
decide to…「決定要…」。happened（發生）、arrived（到達）、belonged（屬於）都不能接 to play。

passages.zh: 我哥哥是《哈利波特》的超級粉絲。他生日時，我買了一盒「各種口味」的雷根糖給他，就像電影裡的那種。每顆糖的味道都不一樣，你永遠不知道會吃到哪一種。我們輪流吃。我的第一顆是草莓口味，甜甜的。哥哥吃到檸檬口味，酸到他閉上眼睛。接著妹妹吃到一顆吃起來像胡椒的黑色糖，非常辣，她喝了一整杯牛奶。最可怕的是一顆綠色的，吃起來像舊草，好苦。哥哥笑到從椅子上摔下來。「這是我收過最棒的禮物！」他說。我們決定過年時要和表兄弟姊妹再玩一次。

passages.title: 貓咪嚐不出甜味
passages.text: My cat, Momo, loves fish, but she does not care about cake at all. I was always {1} about why. Then I found an article online. It said that cats cannot taste {2} things! Their tongues do not have the parts that find sugar. That's why Momo walks away from ice cream. Dogs are different. My neighbor's dog, Coco, loves sweet fruit like apples and bananas. But {3} food is bad for both cats and dogs, so we should never give them potato chips. The article also said that cats are very good at tasting {4} things. Many dangerous plants taste bitter, so cats can {5} them. Now I understand Momo better. She is not being rude to my cake. She just can't taste it!

blanks.why: be curious about…「對…感到好奇」。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 about why 形容心情。
貓嚐不出甜 sweet 的東西，因為舌頭找不到糖。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容食物。
鹹的 salty 食物對貓狗都不好，所以不能給洋芋片。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容食物。
貓很會嚐出苦 bitter 的東西，下一句也說危險植物是苦的。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、nervous（緊張的）都不能形容味道。
avoid them「避開它們」。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、belong（屬於）都不能接受詞 them。

passages.zh: 我的貓咪桃桃很愛吃魚，卻對蛋糕一點興趣都沒有。我一直很好奇為什麼。後來我在網路上找到一篇文章，上面說貓嚐不出甜的東西！牠們的舌頭沒有能感覺糖的部分，難怪桃桃看到冰淇淋就走開。狗就不一樣了，我鄰居的狗 Coco 很喜歡蘋果、香蕉這些甜甜的水果。不過，鹹的食物對貓和狗都不好，所以我們絕對不能給牠們吃洋芋片。那篇文章還說，貓很會嚐出苦味。很多危險的植物都是苦的，所以貓可以避開它們。現在我更了解桃桃了。牠不是看不起我的蛋糕，牠只是嚐不出味道而已！

passages.title: 第一杯黑咖啡
passages.text: I have always thought that drinking black coffee makes people look cool. My dad drinks it every morning without sugar or milk, and he usually eats a {1} cracker with it. "Salty and bitter go well together," he says. Last Sunday, I asked him if I could try. Dad smiled and gave me a small cup. I took a big sip, and my face changed at once. It was so {2} that I almost spit it out! "How can you drink this every day?" I asked. Dad laughed. "When I was your age, I hated it too." Then he added some milk and two spoons of {3} to my cup. Now it was {4} and smooth. I liked it much better. But Mom said kids should not drink too much coffee, because it can make it hard to {5} at night.

blanks.why: 配一片鹹的 salty 蘇打餅，下一句也說 Salty and bitter。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容餅乾。
黑咖啡苦 bitter 到差點吐出來。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容咖啡。
two spoons of sugar「兩匙糖」，加了才變甜。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、noise（噪音）都不能加進咖啡。
加了牛奶和糖，變得甜 sweet 又順口。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容咖啡。
hard to sleep「難以入睡」，咖啡會讓人睡不著。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、belong（屬於）都和咖啡的影響無關。

passages.zh: 我一直覺得喝黑咖啡的人看起來很酷。我爸爸每天早上都喝不加糖、不加奶的咖啡，通常還會配一片鹹鹹的蘇打餅。「鹹味和苦味很搭。」他說。上星期天，我問他可不可以試喝看看。爸爸笑著給我一小杯。我喝了一大口，臉色馬上變了，苦到我差點吐出來！「你怎麼能每天喝這個？」我問。爸爸笑了。「我像你這麼大的時候，也很討厭它。」接著他在我的杯子裡加了一些牛奶和兩匙糖。現在它變得又甜又順口，我喜歡多了。不過媽媽說，小孩不應該喝太多咖啡，因為晚上會睡不著。

passages.title: 送給德國筆友的鳳梨酥
passages.text: When my pen pal from Germany, Lena, came to Taiwan, I wanted to give her a special gift. Mom suggested pineapple cakes. We visited a famous bakery in Taichung and tried many kinds. The traditional ones were very {1}. The new kind uses real pineapple, so it is a little {2} too. There was even one with salted egg yolk inside. It was sweet and {3} at the same time. In the end, I bought a box with all three kinds. When Lena opened the box, she tried one of each. "I like the sour one best!" she said. She took the rest home to {4} with her family. Last week, she sent me a message: "My mom loves them! Where can she {5} more?"

blanks.why: 傳統鳳梨酥很甜 sweet。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容點心。
用真的鳳梨做，所以有點酸 sour，後面 Lena 也說 the sour one。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
包鹹蛋黃的，又甜又鹹 salty。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容味道。
帶回家和家人分享 share。happen（發生）、belong（屬於）、arrive（到達）都不能和 with her family 表示分享。
Where can she find more?「她可以在哪裡找到更多？」find 可以接受詞 more。happen、belong、arrive 都不能接受詞。

passages.zh: 我的德國筆友 Lena 來台灣時，我想送她一份特別的禮物。媽媽建議送鳳梨酥。我們去了台中一家有名的糕餅店，試吃了好多種。傳統的鳳梨酥非常甜；新的那種用真的鳳梨做，所以也帶一點酸；甚至還有一種包了鹹蛋黃，吃起來又甜又鹹。最後，我買了一盒三種口味都有的。Lena 打開盒子後，每一種都吃了一個。「我最喜歡酸的那種！」她說。她把剩下的帶回家和家人分享。上星期，她傳訊息給我：「我媽媽超愛的！她可以去哪裡買到更多？」

passages.title: 番茄是水果還是蔬菜？
passages.text: Is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable? My classmates could not {1} on the answer. Our science teacher said that a tomato is a fruit, because it has seeds inside. But in the kitchen, people usually cook it like a vegetable. In Taiwan, we eat it both ways. My mom uses big red tomatoes in {2} dishes like tomato egg soup. But in summer, my grandpa buys small cherry tomatoes, which are very {3}. In southern Taiwan, people eat them with a special sauce made of soy sauce paste, sugar, and ginger. The sauce is salty and sweet, and the ginger makes it a little {4}. The first time I tried it, I thought it was strange. Now it is my {5} summer snack. So is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable? I think it is both!

blanks.why: agree on the answer「對答案意見一致」。happen（發生）、arrive（到達）、belong（屬於）都不能和 on the answer 表示意見一致。
番茄蛋花湯是鹹的 salty 料理。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容菜。
小番茄很甜 sweet。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容番茄。
薑讓醬汁帶一點辣 spicy。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容醬汁。
my favorite summer snack「我最愛的夏天點心」。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容點心。

passages.zh: 番茄到底是水果還是蔬菜？我們班同學對答案意見不一。自然老師說，番茄是水果，因為它裡面有種子。但在廚房裡，大家通常把它當蔬菜煮。在台灣，兩種吃法都有。媽媽會用大顆的紅番茄煮鹹的菜，像是番茄蛋花湯。但夏天時，爺爺會買非常甜的小番茄。在南台灣，大家會沾一種用醬油膏、糖和薑做成的特別醬汁吃。醬汁又鹹又甜，薑還讓它帶一點辣。第一次吃的時候，我覺得很奇怪，現在它卻是我夏天最愛的點心。所以番茄是水果還是蔬菜？我覺得兩者都是！

passages.title: 馬拉松跑者臉上的鹽
passages.text: My uncle runs marathons. Last month, I watched him run in the Taipei Marathon. It was a hot day, and when he finished, his face was covered with tiny white crystals. "What's that on your face?" I asked. "Salt!" he laughed. "When you sweat a lot, your body loses salt. That's why sweat tastes {1}." He told me that during long races, runners must drink water and eat a little salt, or their legs may start to {2}. At the water stations, people gave the runners {3} sports drinks and pieces of banana for energy. My uncle also ate some pickled plums. They were very {4}, and they were salty too, so they helped his body. He finished the race in four hours. I was so {5} of him that I gave him a big hug, even though he was very wet.

blanks.why: 汗水裡有鹽，所以嚐起來鹹 salty。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容味道。
腿可能會開始痛 hurt。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、belong（屬於）都不能說明腿的情況。
甜的 sweet 運動飲料可以補充能量。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容飲料。
醃梅子很酸 sour，也有鹹味。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容梅子。
be proud of him「以他為榮」。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、empty（空的）都不能接 of him 形容心情。

passages.zh: 我舅舅會跑馬拉松。上個月，我去看他跑台北馬拉松。那天很熱，他跑完時，臉上布滿了白色的小結晶。「你臉上那是什麼？」我問。「是鹽！」他笑著說，「流很多汗的時候，身體會流失鹽分，所以汗水嚐起來是鹹的。」他告訴我，跑長距離的比賽時，跑者一定要喝水、吃一點鹽，不然腿可能會開始痛。在補給站，工作人員給跑者甜甜的運動飲料和香蕉補充能量。舅舅還吃了一些醃梅子，非常酸，也有鹹味，可以幫助他的身體。他花了四個小時跑完全程。我真是以他為榮，雖然他全身濕答答的，我還是給了他一個大大的擁抱。

passages.title: 燙到舌頭的一星期
passages.text: Last Monday, I drank hot soup too fast and burned my tongue. For a whole week, I couldn't taste anything well. At breakfast, Mom gave me a piece of chocolate cake. Usually it is very {1}, but that day it tasted like paper. At lunch, my friend gave me a lemon candy. I could not even tell if it was {2} or not. The worst part was dinner. Dad made {3} noodles with lots of chili. I couldn't taste the noodles at all, but I could still feel the pain from the chili on my tongue! I had to drink ice water to {4} the pain. By Saturday, my tongue was finally {5} again. On Sunday, I ate a big bowl of ice cream and enjoyed every bite. Now I always wait for my soup to cool down before I drink it.

blanks.why: 巧克力蛋糕平常很甜 sweet，那天卻像紙一樣沒味道。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容蛋糕。
連檸檬糖酸 sour 不酸都分不出來。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容糖果。
加了很多辣椒的辣 spicy 麵。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容麵。
喝冰水來止痛 stop the pain。arrive（到達）、happen（發生）、belong（屬於）都不能接受詞 the pain。
舌頭終於又健康 healthy 了，星期天就能好好吃冰淇淋。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、wooden（木製的）都不能形容舌頭恢復。

passages.zh: 上星期一，我喝熱湯喝太快，燙到了舌頭。整整一個星期，我什麼味道都嚐不太出來。早餐時，媽媽給我一塊巧克力蛋糕，平常它非常甜，那天吃起來卻像紙一樣。午餐時，朋友給我一顆檸檬糖，我連它酸不酸都分不出來。最慘的是晚餐，爸爸煮了加了很多辣椒的辣麵。我完全嚐不到麵的味道，卻還是感覺得到辣椒刺痛舌頭！我只好喝冰水止痛。到了星期六，我的舌頭終於又健康了。星期天，我吃了一大碗冰淇淋，每一口都好享受。現在我喝湯之前，都會先等它變涼。

passages.title: 冬至的湯圓之爭
passages.text: On the winter solstice, Taiwanese people eat tangyuan, small round balls made of sticky rice. But my family can never agree on one thing: should they be sweet or salty? Grandma makes {1} tangyuan in red bean soup with brown sugar. Grandpa says that is for kids. He likes {2} ones in soup with pork, mushrooms, and vegetables. My uncle always adds chili oil to his bowl to make it {3}. Every year, they {4} about it at the dinner table. This year, my mom found a way to make everyone happy. She cooked both kinds in two big pots, and everyone had to try both. Nobody was {5} this time. Grandpa even said, "The sweet ones are not bad." Grandma laughed and gave him a second bowl.

blanks.why: 外婆煮的是加黑糖的紅豆湯圓，是甜的 sweet。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容湯圓。
外公喜歡加豬肉、香菇的鹹 salty 湯圓。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容湯圓。
加辣油讓它變辣 spicy。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容湯圓。
fight about it「為這件事吵架」。belong（屬於）、happen（發生）、arrive（到達）都不能和 about it 表示爭吵。
這次沒有人生氣 angry。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人的情緒。

passages.zh: 冬至那天，台灣人會吃湯圓，就是用糯米做成的小圓球。但我們家永遠有一件事意見不合：湯圓到底該吃甜的還是鹹的？外婆會煮加了黑糖的紅豆甜湯圓。外公說那是給小孩吃的，他喜歡加了豬肉、香菇和青菜的鹹湯圓。舅舅則每次都在碗裡加辣油，讓湯圓變辣。每年，他們都會在餐桌上為這件事吵架。今年，媽媽想到一個讓大家都開心的方法。她用兩個大鍋子把兩種都煮了，每個人都得兩種都吃。這次沒有人生氣，外公甚至說：「甜的也還不錯。」外婆笑著又幫他盛了一碗。

passages.title: 小熊找食物
passages.text: Little Bear woke up early one spring morning, and he was very {1}. "Today, I will find something yummy," he said. First, he found some wild berries. He ate one, but it was so {2} that his eyes watered. Next, he found some leaves near the river. They looked fresh, but they were {3}, so he spat them out. Then he smelled something {4} in an old tree. It was honey! But when he reached for it, the bees chased him away. Little Bear ran home and told Mama Bear everything. She laughed and gave him some dried fish that she had kept from last year. "Sometimes the best food is at home," she said. Little Bear ate all of it. It was a little {5}, but it was the most delicious food he had ever eaten.

blanks.why: 早上起床肚子很餓 hungry，所以要去找食物。honest（誠實的）、careless（粗心的）、rude（無禮的）都不是去找食物的原因。
野莓酸 sour 到眼睛流淚。lazy（懶惰的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容莓果。
葉子很苦 bitter，所以吐出來。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容葉子的味道。
聞到甜甜的 sweet 味道，原來是蜂蜜。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容氣味。
魚乾有點鹹 salty。careless、lazy、polite 都不能形容魚乾。

passages.zh: 一個春天的早晨，小熊很早就醒來，肚子非常餓。「今天我要找到好吃的東西。」他說。首先，他找到一些野莓，吃了一顆，卻酸到眼淚都流出來了。接著，他在河邊找到一些葉子，看起來很新鮮，但吃起來很苦，他只好把它吐出來。然後，他在一棵老樹裡聞到甜甜的味道，是蜂蜜！可是當他伸手去拿的時候，蜜蜂把他趕跑了。小熊跑回家，把一切都告訴熊媽媽。熊媽媽笑了，拿出去年存下來的魚乾給他。「有時候最好吃的東西就在家裡。」她說。小熊全部吃光了。魚乾有一點鹹，卻是他吃過最美味的食物。

passages.title: 爺爺的橄欖
passages.text: When I failed my math test, I felt terrible. My grandpa saw my sad face and gave me a small green fruit. "Eat this," he said. "It's an olive." I put it in my mouth and took a bite. It was so {1} and a little {2} that I wanted to spit it out. "Don't spit it out. Keep chewing," Grandpa said. I {3} chewing. Slowly, the bitter taste went away, and my mouth began to feel {4}. Grandpa smiled. "Life is like this olive. Bad times are bitter, but if you don't give up, sweet times will come." I thought about his words all night. The next week, I studied hard and asked my teacher for help. On the next test, I got 85. I was so {5} of myself, and I bought Grandpa a bag of olives.

blanks.why: 橄欖很苦 bitter，想吐出來。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容橄欖。
又苦又帶點酸 sour。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
keep + V-ing「繼續做…」，kept 是 keep 的過去式。happened（發生）、arrived（到達）、belonged（屬於）都不能接 chewing。
苦味過去後，嘴巴開始覺得甜 sweet，也就是「苦盡甘來」。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容嘴裡的味道。
be proud of myself「為自己感到驕傲」，因為考了 85 分。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、empty（空的）都不能接 of myself 形容心情。

passages.zh: 我數學考不及格的時候，心情很糟。爺爺看到我難過的臉，給了我一顆綠色的小果子。「吃吃看，」他說，「這是橄欖。」我把它放進嘴裡咬了一口，又苦又有點酸，讓我想把它吐出來。「不要吐，繼續嚼。」爺爺說。我繼續嚼，慢慢地，苦味不見了，嘴裡開始有甜甜的味道。爺爺笑了。「人生就像這顆橄欖。不好的時候很苦，但只要不放棄，甜的日子就會來。」那天晚上，我一直想著他的話。下個星期，我認真讀書，還去請老師幫忙。下一次考試我考了 85 分。我好為自己驕傲，還買了一包橄欖送給爺爺。

passages.title: 曼谷的酸辣湯
passages.text: Last winter vacation, my family went to Bangkok, Thailand. On our first night, we ate at a small restaurant by the river. Dad ordered tom yum soup, a famous Thai dish. The soup was red and smelled wonderful. When I tried it, my mouth was full of surprises. First, it was very {1} because of the chili. Then it was {2}, because the cook put in a lot of lime juice. After that, I could taste a little {3} sugar and {4} fish sauce, too. "Thai food has four tastes in one bowl," the waiter said. My little sister could not eat spicy food, so the cook made her some fried rice instead. By the end of the trip, I loved Thai food so much that I wanted to {5} how to cook it. Now I make tom yum soup for my family once a month.

blanks.why: 因為辣椒，所以很辣 spicy。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容湯。
加了很多萊姆汁，所以很酸 sour。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
嚐到一點甜甜的 sweet 糖。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容糖。
魚露是鹹的 salty。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容魚露。
learn how to cook it「學怎麼煮」。happen（發生）、arrive（到達）、belong（屬於）都不能接 how to…。

passages.zh: 去年寒假，我們全家去泰國曼谷。第一天晚上，我們在河邊一家小餐廳吃飯。爸爸點了有名的泰國菜：泰式酸辣湯。湯是紅色的，聞起來好香。我喝了一口，嘴巴裡充滿了驚喜。一開始因為辣椒，非常辣；接著很酸，因為廚師加了很多萊姆汁；然後我還嚐到一點甜甜的糖和鹹鹹的魚露。「泰國菜一碗裡就有四種味道。」服務生說。我妹妹不能吃辣，所以廚師幫她做了一盤炒飯。旅行結束時，我已經愛上泰國菜，還想學怎麼煮。現在我每個月都會煮一次酸辣湯給家人喝。

passages.title: 營養午餐大改造
passages.text: At our school, many students did not like the school lunch. "The soup is too {1}," some said. "The vegetables are {2}," others said. Lots of food went into the trash can every day. So our student council did a survey and wrote down everyone's ideas. Then they {3} the cooks to a meeting. The cooks listened carefully and made some changes. Now they use less salt in the soup. They cook the bitter vegetables with a little garlic, so they don't taste so bad. On Fridays, they make sweet and sour chicken, and once a month, there is a {4} curry day for students who like hot food. Most students are happy now, and there is much less food {5} than before. Even our teacher says the lunch is better than the food in some restaurants.

blanks.why: 湯太鹹 salty，後面也說改成少放鹽。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容湯。
蔬菜很苦 bitter，後面說用大蒜炒就沒那麼難吃。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容蔬菜。
invite the cooks to a meeting「邀請廚師來開會」。happened（發生）、arrived（到達）、belonged（屬於）都不能接受詞 the cooks。
辣的 spicy 咖哩日，給喜歡吃辣的同學。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容咖哩。
food waste「廚餘、食物浪費」，丟掉的食物變少了。weather（天氣）、history（歷史）、traffic（交通）都和丟掉的食物無關。

passages.zh: 在我們學校，很多學生不喜歡營養午餐。「湯太鹹了。」有些人說。「青菜很苦。」另一些人說。每天都有很多食物被倒進垃圾桶。所以我們的學生會做了問卷調查，把大家的想法都寫下來，然後邀請廚房的阿姨叔叔來開會。他們很認真地聽，也做了一些改變。現在湯裡放的鹽變少了；苦的青菜會加一點大蒜一起炒，就沒那麼難吃了。每個星期五有糖醋雞，每個月還有一次給愛吃辣的同學的辣味咖哩日。現在大部分的學生都很滿意，廚餘也比以前少了很多。連我們老師都說，午餐比有些餐廳的菜還好吃。

passages.title: 媽媽懷孕後的怪口味
passages.text: Since my mom became pregnant, she has wanted to eat strange things. Last week, she woke up at midnight and asked Dad to buy her something {1}. Dad went to the convenience store and came back with lemons and green mangoes. Mom ate three lemons with no sugar! Two days later, she wanted something very {2}. She ate a whole bowl of hot pot with extra chili. Then, the next morning, she put {3} potato chips on her ice cream. "It's {4} and salty at the same time. It's perfect!" she said. Dad and I looked at each other. "Is this normal?" I asked. Dad laughed and said, "When you were in her stomach, she ate pickles with chocolate cake." I can't {5} to meet my little brother. I just hope he likes normal food.

blanks.why: 想吃酸的 sour 東西，所以爸爸買了檸檬和青芒果。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容食物。
吃加了很多辣椒的火鍋，想吃很辣 spicy 的東西。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容食物。
洋芋片是鹹的 salty，下一句也說 sweet and salty。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容洋芋片。
冰淇淋是甜的 sweet，配洋芋片又甜又鹹。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容味道。
can't wait to…「等不及要…」。belong（屬於）、happen（發生）、spell（拼字）都不能和 can't … to meet 表示期待。

passages.zh: 自從媽媽懷孕以後，她就一直想吃奇怪的東西。上星期，她半夜醒來，叫爸爸去買酸的東西給她。爸爸去便利商店，買了檸檬和青芒果回來，媽媽不加糖就吃了三顆檸檬！兩天後，她想吃很辣的東西，吃了一整碗加了很多辣椒的火鍋。接著隔天早上，她把鹹鹹的洋芋片放在冰淇淋上。「又甜又鹹，太完美了！」她說。我和爸爸互看了一眼。「這樣正常嗎？」我問。爸爸笑著說：「你還在她肚子裡的時候，她吃醃黃瓜配巧克力蛋糕呢。」我等不及要見到我的弟弟了，只希望他喜歡正常的食物。

passages.title: 澎湖的海鹽冰淇淋
passages.text: Last summer, my family took a boat to Penghu. It was very hot, so the first thing we did was look for ice cream. We found a small shop near the beach that sold sea salt ice cream. "Salt in ice cream? That sounds strange," I said. The owner {1} that he makes the salt himself from Penghu's sea water. I tried a spoon. At first, it was {2}, like normal milk ice cream. Then I tasted a little salt at the end. It was not too {3} at all. Instead, the salt made the sweet taste even stronger. My brother chose a {4} passion fruit flavor, and Dad tried a {5} dark coffee one. They were good, but in the end, all of us agreed that the sea salt one was the best. Before we left Penghu, we went back to that shop two more times.

blanks.why: explain that…「解釋說…」。arrived（到達）、happened（發生）、belonged（屬於）都不能接 that 子句。
一開始像一般牛奶冰淇淋一樣甜 sweet。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容冰淇淋。
一點也不會太鹹 salty。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容味道。
百香果口味是酸的 sour。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容口味。
黑咖啡口味是苦的 bitter。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容口味。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家搭船去澎湖。天氣非常熱，所以我們做的第一件事就是找冰淇淋。我們在海邊找到一家賣海鹽冰淇淋的小店。「冰淇淋裡加鹽？聽起來好奇怪。」我說。老闆解釋說，他用澎湖的海水親手做鹽。我吃了一口，一開始就像一般的牛奶冰淇淋一樣甜，最後才嚐到一點點鹹味。一點也不會太鹹，反而讓甜味更明顯。弟弟選了酸酸的百香果口味，爸爸試了苦苦的黑咖啡口味。它們都不錯，但最後我們都同意海鹽口味最好吃。離開澎湖之前，我們又去了那家店兩次。

passages.title: 為什麼小孩怕苦？
passages.text: Why do most kids hate {1} vegetables like bitter melon, while many adults love them? Scientists say it has to do with our tongues. Kids have more taste buds than adults, so every taste feels much stronger to them. A little bitter taste can feel terrible to a child. Kids also love {2} food, because sugar gives their growing bodies lots of energy. As we get older, we slowly lose some taste buds. That's why many adults can enjoy black coffee or very {3} food with chili. So if your little brother won't eat his vegetables, don't be {4} with him. His tongue is just different from yours. Try cooking the vegetables with a little {5} soy sauce or some cheese. It might help him like them more!

blanks.why: 小孩討厭苦 bitter 的蔬菜，例如苦瓜。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容蔬菜。
小孩愛甜 sweet 的食物，因為糖給身體能量。careless（粗心的）、polite（有禮貌的）、shy（害羞的）都不能形容食物。
大人能吃加辣椒的很辣 spicy 的食物。brave（勇敢的）、patient（有耐心的）、curious（好奇的）都不能形容食物。
be angry with…「對某人生氣」。wooden（木製的）、empty（空的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 with him 形容情緒。
醬油是鹹的 salty。nervous（緊張的）、crowded（擁擠的）、honest 都不能形容醬油。

passages.zh: 為什麼大部分的小孩討厭苦瓜這類苦苦的蔬菜，很多大人卻很喜歡呢？科學家說，這和我們的舌頭有關。小孩的味蕾比大人多，所以每一種味道對他們來說都強烈得多，一點點苦味就可能讓小孩覺得很可怕。小孩也很愛吃甜的食物，因為糖能給成長中的身體很多能量。隨著年紀變大，我們的味蕾會慢慢減少，所以很多大人能享受黑咖啡或加了辣椒的超辣食物。所以，如果你弟弟不吃青菜，不要對他生氣，他的舌頭只是和你的不一樣。試試看用一點鹹鹹的醬油或起司來煮青菜，也許會讓他比較喜歡吃！
